text:
alex: heads up :rotating_light: customers seeing a spike of 5xx/timeouts on hosted inference. p95 token latency jumped to ~3.2s and we have a wave of 504s. Initial traces point at request queue saturation in continuous-batching pools (cbatcher-*). Repro notes & logs below.

nina: which customers hit this? any auth/billing patterns?

alex: acme-pay, notate.inc, and one internal canary. not auth or billing — requests reach gateway then stall in cbatcher enqueue. sample gateway log:
```
2026-03-17T16:04:21Z gateway request_id=req-9d2f status=504 detail="deadline exceeded waiting for dequeue" pool=cbatcher-02
2026-03-17T16:04:22Z batcher pool=cbatcher-02 enqueue_depth=18234 batch_size=1 kv_cache_miss=0.82
```

tyler: looking at metrics — enqueue_depth ~18k vs queue_depth_limit=16000. We started early rejects and fallback routing kicked in, but many longseq requests kept piling up and prevented batching. KV cache miss rate spiked (0.8) which amplified tail latency.

maria: observed memory pressure on cbatcher nodes during spin-up; KV cache warmup seems to stall dequeue workers.

ops-bot: :gear: starting emergency config roll: cbatcher-config-333 -> cbatcher-01..04 (reduce max_batch_time + enable shed_fast)

maria: deployed config change to reduce max_batch_time from 20ms -> 8ms on cbatcher-01/02 in prod. also temporarily lowered max_queue_accept=15000.

nina: acme-pay reports partial improvement, 504s dropped but longseq (>2k token) still time out occasionally. they sent a sample repro payload.

alex: repro curl we used locally to simulate:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"'$(python -c 'print("x\n"*2200)')'"}'
```

tyler: mitigation notes: 1) scale cbatcher pool +2 nodes (in progress), 2) enable per-tenant queue caps so a heavy tenant doesn't starve others, 3) route longseq/large-token requests to dedicated_thin models or Dedicated deployments, 4) add alert at 75% of queue_depth_limit and an SLO for dequeue latency.

maria: follow-up patch: cap per-tenant KV cache entries and add graceful warmup to avoid dequeue stalls. will open PR with rollout plan.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: cbatcher-config-333 applied to cbatcher-01/02, scale job started for cbatcher-03/04. deploy id=deploy-20260317-09

alex: immediate customer impact: 504s in last 15m dropped from ~1200 -> ~240 after config + scale started. still monitoring.

nina: I've opened support tickets for acme-pay and notate.inc; advised temporary retry/backoff and chunking for long inputs.

tyler: long term action items: add tenant queue isolation, reduce default max_batch_time for high-variance workloads, improve KV cache eviction heuristics, and run a continuous-batching backpressure loadtest to repro. I'll file the follow-up incident report.

alex: thanks everyone. tagging SRE/Support for postmortem and customer comms. :thumbsup:
